content.title: About
content.content: Cafe Mocha is a fragrant beverage made from espresso, chocolate syrup, and nonfat milk. It combines the bitterness of coffee, the sweetness of cocoa, and a light creamy texture, but without added fat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The name “Mocha” comes from the Yemeni port city of Mocha, historically known for its coffee beans.
Cafe Mocha is often considered the “chocolate” version of a latte, but with a stronger cocoa flavor.
The nonfat version retains the taste notes while providing fewer calories and virtually no saturated fat.
The aromatic chocolate in the drink may improve mood by boosting serotonin levels.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Both coffee and cocoa contain polyphenols that help combat free radicals and support cellular health.

items.title: Boosts concentration
items.content: Caffeine in espresso stimulates the central nervous system, enhancing alertness and reaction time.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Moderate coffee consumption is linked to lower risk of hypertension and stroke.

items.title: Low‑calorie option
items.content: Nonfat milk reduces the drink’s calorie count, making it suitable for weight‑watching individuals.

items.title: Source of magnesium
items.content: Coffee provides magnesium, which is important for muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some people may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat after caffeine intake.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee’s high acidity can irritate the stomach in individuals with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Chocolate allergy
items.content: Rarely, an allergic reaction to cocoa components can occur.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Caffeine may amplify the effects of certain stimulants and reduce the efficacy of sedatives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy Cafe Mocha hot or iced, adding sweetener to taste. It can also serve as a base for dessert cocktails, smoothies, or be drizzled over ice cream.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store dry ingredients (coffee, chocolate syrup) in a sealed container in a cool, dry place. Keep nonfat milk refrigerated and use within 5‑7 days after opening.
